overview:
**High fire danger holds today, driven by very low humidity and a climbing Energy Release Component.**
- ERC keeps rising toward 89% by Thursday while Burning Index eases from 90% to the low-70s by next Monday.
- Winds stay light from the NE (12 mph today, dropping to 7-8 mph later this week) with dry afternoons continuing.
- Two of seven local watchout thresholds are met today (min RH 18%, max RH 46%); no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for this area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands across Montrose, Delta, Mesa, Gunnison, Ouray and San Miguel counties through year-end, while San Miguel County is under Stage 2 restrictions on private and federal land.
- The Gold Mountain Fire, northeast of Ouray, has burned 39,691 acres and is 87% contained; the Elk Fire near Grand Mesa/Uncompahgre/Gunnison National Forest sits at 7,374 acres, 35% contained.
- Light rain (up to 0.09") may arrive late week, but High danger persists through August 24.
